job.title: Administration & Finance Officer
job.description:
ho we are

Distribution 360 are a proudly South Australian business who are doing their bit to create a cleaner environment.

We work with local councils, businesses and residents to safely remove and reliably recycle rubbish across our state. We're focussed on getting the job done quickly and cleanly and offer a range of services including our end-to-end bulky goods removal and mattress recycling.

Ultimately, we're a passionate group of locals who are doing their bit to create a rubbish-responsible future for our planet.

We're on the hunt for an Administration Officer to work in a job share arrangement, keeping our office – and our drivers – organised and on track.

So, what's the role?

Your day starts with reviewing the previous day's dockets to reconcile and invoice each job.

You'll take ownership of accounts receivable and payable, including taking payments, and keeping things running smoothly by scheduling and planning the day ahead – building the skeleton structure for upcoming jobs. Email management is a big part of the role too, coordinating logistics and calls with our drivers and customers.

You'll also pull together regular reporting to keep the team informed and take care of some light housekeeping and amenities for your own workspace (we have a cleaner in routinely).

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone who loves organising - and keeping others organised!

You’re also someone who can be relied on to get the job done but is also up to helping the team with broader tasks when required.

You're reliable, and comfortable managing your workload without losing your attention to detail. You'll be confident with AR/AP, reconciliations and invoicing, and a whiz with technology including Outlook and Excel.  Cash Flow Manager experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

You’ll love engaging with our customers and ensuring high quality support and resolution of scheduling requirements.

You're happy working closely alongside a teammate but just as comfortable holding down the fort on your own to keep things ticking along. 

What's in it for you?

We're offering this role on a part time basis – 2 to 3 days a week, with the need to pick up extra shifts covering leave. You'll typically start around 9am with the option to wrap up on-site by 3pm, then shift to a short work-from-home stretch monitoring calls and emails until 5pm.

Your regular office days can be negotiated to suit, with one work-from-home day each week – a great mix of routine and flexibility.

We're also offering a competitive hourly rate, reviewed in line with experience.
Most importantly, we are passionate about offering a workplace where our team feels valued.

How do I apply?

If you fit the brief and are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a great local business who is doing their bit for the world, we can't wait to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact Tracy Frankenfeld at Mansfield & Co on 0493 703 697 or tracy@mansfieldandco.com.au

job.title: Submissions Coordinator
job.description:
Who’s hiring?
FMG Engineering is an award-winning, multi-disciplinary engineering consultancy with more than 50 years' experience and a presence across South Australia, Victoria, New South Wales and Queensland.

With a team of more than 180 people nationally, FMG brings together engineers, scientists, technicians and other professionals to work across a diverse range of projects. Their culture is built around integrity, teamwork and collaboration, with people encouraged to share ideas and contribute to better outcomes.

Importantly, this is a business that genuinely values work/life balance. Flexibility is embedded in the way they work, with options including working from home, flexible hours and, after 12 months, the opportunity to work a compressed fortnight.

So, what’s the role?
Reporting to the Business Development Manager, you'll take ownership of the end-to-end coordination of FMG's submissions nationally, from smaller EOIs through to larger and more complex tenders.

This is an opportunity to bring your expertise and ideas to the role – refining what's already in place, identifying opportunities to improve and continuing to elevate the quality of FMG's submissions.

In this busy yet rewarding role you’ll:
  • Coordinate EOIs, RFPs and tender submissions from start to finish
  • Establish submission schedules, review milestones and version control
  • Work with stakeholders across the business to gather information and develop strong, compelling content
  • Draft and edit non-technical content, including company information, project experience and capability statements
  • Format and produce professional submissions using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Adobe InDesign
  • Develop graphics including organisation charts, infographics and presentations
  • Maintain the bid knowledge library, including project sheets, CVs, imagery and corporate information
  • Support the BD Manager with tender monitoring and coordination of BD and client meetings
  • Coordinate industry awards and proposals alongside the marketing team
  • Bring ideas to continually refine and improve the submissions process
While you'll be supporting the business nationally, no travel is required.

What are we looking for?
We're looking for someone who knows the submissions space and is confident taking ownership of it.

Ideally, you'll bring:
  • Previous experience coordinating bids, tenders, proposals or submissions
  • Experience within the engineering or construction sector
  • Excellent written communication skills and a strong eye for detail
  • Strong Microsoft Word and PowerPoint skills, with Adobe Creative Suite experience highly regarded
  • The ability to work independently, prioritise competing deadlines and keep things moving
  • Confidence building relationships and working with stakeholders across different areas of the business
  • A proactive approach – you're comfortable bringing ideas forward and looking for ways to improve
  • A genuine sense of pride in the quality of work you produce
What’s in it for you?
Along with a role where you'll have plenty of ownership and the opportunity to make an impact, FMG offers:
  • Work from home up to two days per week once established
  • Flexible working hours and a genuine focus on work/life balance
  • Access to a compressed working fortnight after 12 months
  • Ability for full-time employees to purchase additional leave
  • One paid volunteer day each year
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Training and professional development support - Employee recognition and service awards
If you're an experienced Submissions Coordinator looking for more ownership, flexibility and the opportunity to bring your ideas to a business that values quality and balance, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Melanie Mansfield at Mansfield & Co Recruitment on 0411 471 822.

job.title: Payroll Officer
job.description:
Who's hiring?
We’re partnering with an organisation in Adelaide’s eastern suburbs looking for an experienced Payroll Officer to support their team for an initial 3-month temporary contract.

This is a varied role responsible for the accurate and timely processing of end-to-end payroll across multiple awards. You’ll also assist employees and managers with payroll queries, maintain accurate employee information and help resolve any discrepancies.

A typical week might see you:
  • Processing end-to-end payroll accurately and on time
  • Reviewing timesheets and correcting time and attendance errors
  • Maintaining payroll records for new starters and employee changes
  • Processing deductions, allowances, leave and pay adjustments
  • Interpreting and applying multiple awards and relevant pay conditions
  • Investigating payroll discrepancies and responding to employee queries
  • Assisting managers with timesheet and payroll-related issues
  • Completing payroll reporting and reconciliations
  • Identifying opportunities to improve payroll processes
  • Maintaining confidentiality across all employee and payroll information
To be successful, you’ll have:
  • Previous end-to-end payroll processing experience
  • Confidence working across multiple awards
  • Good knowledge of payroll legislation and relevant employee entitlements
  • Dayforce experience would be highly regarded
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Good Excel and broader Microsoft Office skills
  • The ability to manage deadlines and resolve payroll queries promptly
  • A helpful and professional approach when communicating with employees and managers
What’s in it for you?
  • ASAP start
  • Initial 3-month temporary contract
  • Varied end-to-end payroll responsibilities
  • Eastern suburbs location
  • Join a collaborative and supportive team
If you’re available immediately and looking for your next payroll opportunity, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Financial Accountant
job.description:
Financial Accountant | 3-Month Contract 

We’re looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join the finance team of a global organisation for a three-month contract, supporting a key project transitioning the organisation’s functional currency from USD to AUD.
Based in the Adelaide CBD, this is a great opportunity for someone with technical accounting and financial reporting experience, along with a solid understanding of foreign currency accounting.

A typical week might see you:
  • Supporting the transition of functional currency from USD to AUD
  • Preparing financial schedules, reconciliations and working papers
  • Assisting with financial reporting and consolidation activities
  • Reconciling balances across financial systems and reporting
  • Preparing documentation to support audit requirements
  • Working closely with the broader finance team throughout the project
What we're looking for:
  • Demonstrated financial accounting and reporting experience
  • Strong knowledge of foreign currency accounting
  • Experience with consolidation processes
  • Strong reconciliation and analytical skills
  • Confidence preparing detailed working papers and supporting schedules
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Ability to work autonomously and hit the ground running
  • Pronto experience would be advantageous, but isn't essential
What’s in it for you?
  • Three-month contract, full-time hours
  • Convenient Adelaide CBD location
  • Immediate start
  • Interesting, project-focused accounting work
  • Opportunity to work within a global organisation
  • Competitive hourly rate based on experience
If you’re an experienced Financial Accountant with strong foreign currency accounting knowledge and are available for your next contract opportunity, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now or get in touch with Mansfield & Co for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Management Accountant
job.description:
Who's hiring?
Gannon Lifestyle Communities is a South Australian owned and operated business specialising in retirement villages and land lease communities.
With a growing portfolio and further growth ahead, the business has created this new Management Accountant position to strengthen its finance capability and provide greater insight and support across its operations.

Based at their Hackney Head Office, you'll join a small, high-performing team of genuine, down-to-earth and friendly people who enjoy working together. It's a family-friendly environment where people are trusted to get on with their jobs, with a genuine focus on balance and flexibility.

So, what's the role?
Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll take responsibility for management accounting across the Group's retirement village, land lease community and development operations.

It's a broad role with a strong focus on budgeting, forecasting, reporting and statutory compliance, while also providing financial analysis and insights to support decision-making across the business.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Preparing budgets, forecasts and cash flow forecasts across the Group.
  • Preparing management, Board and actual versus budget reporting.
  • Providing financial analysis across existing operations and future growth opportunities.
  • Managing monthly and quarterly reconciliations, including inter-entity transactions.
  • Supporting financial reporting and cash flow management across development projects.
  • Working with external accountants and auditors to support year-end reporting and annual audits.
  • Ensuring statutory obligations including payroll tax, superannuation and ATO requirements are met.
  • Maintaining the integrity of financial information across Xero, Salesforce and other business systems.
  • Supporting the COO and CEO with investor reporting and other financial information as required.
You'll also have the opportunity to look at existing processes, systems and reporting and identify ways to make them more efficient. They're very open to new ideas and are looking for someone who will show initiative rather than simply follow the way things have always been done.

What are we looking for?
We're looking for an experienced accountant who enjoys taking ownership, can work independently and is confident managing their own priorities.

Ideally you'll bring:
  • CA or CPA qualification, or are currently working towards it.
  • Management accounting experience across budgeting, forecasting and reporting.
  • Strong financial analysis, reconciliation and month-end accounting skills.
  • Strong Excel skills.
  • Experience using Xero or a similar accounting system.
  • A proactive approach with the confidence to identify and implement improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to meet reporting deadlines.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to contribute as part of a small team.

Why join Gannon Lifestyle Communities?
This is a great opportunity to join a growing business at a time when its finance function is continuing to evolve.

In return you'll enjoy:
  • A newly created role with the opportunity to make it your own.
  • The autonomy to work independently and contribute ideas.
  • A genuinely family-friendly culture that values balance and flexibility.
  • Work from home options.
  • Part-time hours will be considered.
  • Onsite car parking at their Hackney office.
  • Potential career development opportunities as the business continues to grow.
If you're looking for a Management Accountant role where you'll have autonomy, flexibility and the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Melanie Mansfield at Mansfield & Co Recruitment on 0411 471 822.

job.title: Expression of Interest for Temporary Opportunities
job.description:
Expression of Interest | Temporary & Contract Opportunities

Please note: This is an Expression of Interest advertisement and is not for a specific current vacancy.

At Mansfield & Co, we regularly partner with organisations across Adelaide looking for talented people to step into temporary and contract roles – from short-term assignments of a couple of weeks through to longer-term contracts of up to 12 months. Opportunities can be part-time or full-time, depending on the needs of each organisation.

We work with a diverse range of organisations across Adelaide, from small and medium-sized businesses through to larger organisations, not-for-profits and community-based organisations. Our clients span industries including professional services, health and community services, education, energy, manufacturing and more.

We’re looking to grow our network of candidates who are open to temporary or contract work, so when the right opportunity comes up, we know who to call!

We’d love to hear from people with experience across:
  • Human Resources – HR Administration, HR Coordination, HR Advisory, HR Business Partnering and senior HR/generalist roles
  • Finance & Payroll – Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payroll, Assistant Accounting, Accounting, Financial/Management Accounting and Finance Management
  • Administration & Office Support – Reception, Administration, Executive/Personal Assistance, Office Management and senior administrative support
  • Customer Service & Client Support – Customer Service, Contact Centre, Membership, Client Services and Team Leadership
What kind of opportunities could come up?
Temporary and contract assignments can vary quite a bit. You might be looking for a short-term role for a few weeks, a contract spanning several months or up to 12 months or simply want the flexibility that temp and contract work can offer.

We see both part-time and full-time opportunities, with roles coming up across Adelaide, from the CBD through to the inner suburbs and further afield. Hours and working arrangements will vary depending on each assignment.

What we’d love to know about you
If you’re interested in joining our temp network, send through your CV along with an indication of:
  • The type and level of work you’re interested in
  • Your availability and when you could start
  • Whether you’re looking for part-time or full-time opportunities
  • Your preferred locations
  • Whether you’re interested in short-term, long-term or both types of assignments
Enough about us - let’s talk about whether temping could work for you!
Whether you’re immediately available, between permanent roles, returning to work, or simply prefer the flexibility of contract work, we’d love to hear from you.

Again, please note that this advertisement is for Expressions of Interest only and does not relate to a specific current vacancy. Applying will allow our team to consider you for suitable temporary and contract opportunities as they arise.

job.title: HR Advisor
job.description:
This is a great opportunity for an HR professional who wants to broaden their experience beyond traditional advisory work and get closely involved in how a business operates.

Joining an established HR function within a global mining organisation, you'll work closely with the HR Manager across a mix of operational and strategic HR initiatives, with a particular focus on workforce planning, organisational effectiveness and culture. You'll also partner with HR and key stakeholders across multiple locations.

A significant component of the role will be supporting an organisation-wide review of the company's structure and management framework, including workforce planning, reporting lines, accountabilities and the way corporate and mine-site operations work together.

What’s in it for you?
  • 6–12 month, full-time contract with the potential to become permanent
  • Exposure to a global business and the mining industry
  • Work closely with an experienced HR Manager and in-house legal team
  • Build your experience across organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, governance and project work
  • Exposure to HR teams and operations across multiple international locations
  • Flexibility around working hours and hybrid arrangements
  • Potential domestic and international travel for someone interested in getting out to operational sites
A typical week might see you:
  • Partnering with HR and operational teams across corporate and mine-site locations
  • Supporting an organisation-wide review of structures, reporting lines, accountabilities and how corporate and operational teams work together
  • Contributing to workforce and capability planning, including role clarity, workforce requirements and succession considerations
  • Supporting the development of practical people frameworks across performance, remuneration, talent and training
  • Helping build and strengthen culture across a diverse, multicultural workforce
  • Using workforce data and reporting to identify trends, provide insights and support decision-making
  • Getting involved in broader HR projects and helping turn recommendations into practical actions
  • Being a visible and approachable member of the HR team, with plenty of day-to-day interaction across the business
  • Working closely with HR colleagues across multiple locations to coordinate projects and broader HR initiatives
Let’s talk about whether this role is for you!

We're looking for someone who brings energy, curiosity and confidence to the HR function. You'll be comfortable asking questions, challenging something when it doesn't quite make sense and getting into the detail of how the organisation operates.

You'll ideally bring:
  • Previous experience in an HR Advisor, HR Generalist or similar role
  • Strong organisation and communication skills, with the confidence to work across different levels of a business
  • An interest in organisational effectiveness, workforce planning and how people, structures and operations work together
  • Strong technology skills and confidence working with data and reporting; Power BI experience would be particularly useful
  • Strong communication skills and confidence building relationships across all areas of the business
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and keep projects moving
  • Project management experience would be highly regarded
  • Exposure to compliance, governance or highly regulated environments would be beneficial, but isn't essential
You don't need previous mining experience. For someone looking to move into the industry, this is a great opportunity to gain exposure to a complex operational environment while learning from an experienced HR team.

If you're an HR professional who enjoys understanding the bigger picture, getting involved in projects and working closely with the business, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Accounts Payable Officer
job.description:
We’re partnering with an established energy company looking for an experienced Accounts Officer to join their finance team on an initial temporary basis, with the potential for the role to become permanent.
You’ll be joining a busy finance team in modern offices. The role has a strong focus on accounts payable, including processing creditor invoices, payments and reconciliations, alongside general finance and administration support. You’ll be joining a busy team, so we’re looking for someone who can pick things up quickly, stay organised and confidently manage their own workload.

What’s in it for you?
  • Full-time role with an immediate start
  • Temporary opportunity with potential to become permanent
  • Modern, newly fitted-out offices with a great breakout space
  • Join an established company within the energy sector
  • Hands-on, accounts payable-focused role
  • Supportive finance team environment
A typical week might see you:
  • Processing creditor invoices and ensuring the correct approvals and supporting documentation are in place
  • Completing creditor reconciliations and preparing payments
  • Responding to and resolving supplier enquiries
  • Processing daily bank transactions
  • Assisting with international purchases and transaction processing
  • Processing expense claims and AMEX transactions
  • Reconciling transactions against supporting documentation
  • Completing month-end reconciliations
  • Assisting with credit applications and supplier administration
  • Providing general finance and administration support to the wider team
Let’s talk about whether this role is for you! We’d love to hear from you if you have:
  • Previous experience in an Accounts Officer, Accounts Administrator, Finance Administrator or similar role
  • Strong accounts payable experience, including invoice processing, payments and creditor reconciliations
  • Experience processing financial transactions and maintaining accurate records
  • Experience handling supplier enquiries and resolving discrepancies
  • Good Excel skills
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle competing priorities
  • A friendly, professional communication style and confidence dealing with suppliers and internal stakeholders
  • The ability to work independently while also working well as part of a team
If you’re an experienced Accounts Officer who is available to start quickly and looking for a temporary opportunity with longer-term potential, we’d love to hear from you.
